title: Any Way to Track the Total Level of all a Character's Classes?

posts.author: Technical-Developer
posts.body:
Trying to create a system where a character gains skills based on the combined level of all classes. The issue I'm having is finding a way to store that value internally. I've tried using a variable to track the levels, but it only tracks the current level and not the overall levels gained. Is there a way to track the levels of all classes and add them together internally?
I'm currently using Yanfly Class Change Core for the different classes.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
you'd have loop to get the levels for each using the actor's exp gained in each class. since youre already using yanfly's class change core though, it cuts most of the work. the script to check would be something like this
Code:
var actor = $gameParty.members()[0];
actor.unlockedClasses().reduce((a,b) => actor.classLevel(b) + a, 0)
and from there you can store the value into a variable or whatever you need to do with it to make it usable
